question: What claim about the uniqueness of this knowledge is at stake in denying that any equal knowledge exists now or will exist again?
premises: A particular knowledge is in view.
No knowledge equal to it exists.
No knowledge equal to it will exist again in the future.
inference: The knowledge in question is presented as unique, with no equal past or future counterpart.
uncertainties: The scope of comparison is not specified here.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this; there will be none again.
